carried.disposition: PR #689 Testing owner records three completed runs against the final SHA, giving the command, SHA, exit and duration against 300 seconds for each. Read back the PR evidence before closing.

reason: Replay the live custody refusal on restart for both integration states. Require exact and current maintainer authority on the actual breach. The four new authority witnesses and the typed restart witnesses are red on the pinned base. The eight controls pass. Mutation not measured.

transitionMatrix.sourceState: An open remediation due on the reviewed or current corrective head. resolve reads review and red-spec handoffs and run-local recovery.json. The driver reads the current Git worktree and custody expects all seals established by the run.
transitionMatrix.eventIdentity: Recovery for the due prepare phase, mode and attempt combines the original expected head, candidate head, integration ref and applicable cycle custody authority. A restart must enforce the same evidence requirement. A maintainer decision grants the named breach code, path and segment only while current and accepted. A deleted or edited source comment loses its authority on successful pickup.
transitionMatrix.predecessorEvidence: The candidate descends from the active expected head. Where the run has a seal and custody applies, verify-chain must accept the candidate itself before it can replace the preparation base. A matching human override may satisfy custody through its existing gate. A prior admitted memo is not current custody after the exact decision is revoked.
transitionMatrix.acceptedTransition: A custody-accepted candidate can become the in-run recovered base, including up-to-date integration. Unsealed recovery retains the existing behavior. The persisted choice and producer packet agree with stage-local resolve.
transitionMatrix.forbiddenTransition: The driver parks with status awaiting-human, zero stages, resume token prepare:r2-g1:prepare-head-mismatch and reason containing base-sync verify-chain failed: custody does not hold. The refused SHA is ineligible, no new prepare packet uses it, and the open finding and reviewed and sealed history remain intact. Mismatched or revoked overrides cannot make the candidate eligible.
transitionMatrix.immutability: Preserve the finding, reviewed Git ancestry, the review handoff, sealed snapshot ancestry and handoff, and the authority of later reviews. Earlier evidence does not transfer to a different candidate.
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: Recovery establishes a preparation base only. Review, custody and blocking findings still govern terminal transitions.
transitionMatrix.metricEffects: A recovery may use a process recovery round within the configured budget. It does not report a prepare dispatch or spend a finding repair on a refused head. A zero recovery budget keeps actual HEAD and the recovery eligibility unchanged.

families.multiGroupApplicability: This transition reads active reviewed or corrective HEAD and current cycle-wide custody. It does not rebind or change group IDs, epochs, or a regression-risk ledger.
